 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    src = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (0, background)]
    dst = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in src), max(r for r, c in src)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in src), max(c for r, c in src)
    dr0, dr1 = min(r for r, c in dst), max(r for r, c in dst)
    dc0, dc1 = min(c for r, c in dst), max(c for r, c in dst)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(dr1 - dr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(dc1 - dc0 + 1):
            out[dr0 + dr][dc0 + dc] = grid[r0 + dr][c1 - dc]
    return out
"
}
